summary: SandRidge Energy Inc filed an 8-K reporting its wholly owned subsidiary's entry into a Purchase and Sale Agreement to acquire oil and gas properties from Rockies Resources Holdings LLC and Rockies Resources Agent Corp. The purchase price is $65 million in cash at closing, with three contingent earn-out payments of $2 million each based on WTI price thresholds through December 2027. The transaction will be funded from cash on hand and is expected to close in Q3 2026. The filing includes customary representations and warranties. Watch for regulatory and customary closing conditions; risk-arb focuses on cash funding and oil price dependence.
